finding.status: confirmed source path; no runtime reproduction
finding.summary: The fresh-namespace credential preflight can mutate a colliding legacy/old-accessibility credential before rejecting it.
finding.cause: runtimeLoginInfo with recordEffect always true calls readRawLoginInfo. Existing legacy userInfo can be inserted into Keychain and deleted from defaults before returning non-nil; the preflight then throws with sourcesOwned=false. The checked existing-login read can also migrate accessibility before rejection.
finding.requestedRepair: Use existing Keychain checked read with accessibility:nil and reject exact existing legacy record before any migration, or an equivalently narrow same-owner pure-read check. Preserve unreadable/malformed failure, Keychain authorization, and nonce-scoped cleanup.
